parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" mapping="logical" distinct="true">
	<entity name="vsb_projectstate">
		<attribute name="statecode"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_projectstateid"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_name"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_isvisibleonchecklist"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_order"/>
		<order attribute="vsb_order" descending="false"/>
		<filter type="and">
			<condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0"/>
   <condition attribute="vsb_isvisibleonchecklist" operator="eq" value="1"/>
   <condition attribute="vsb_order" operator="eq" value="@{sub(outputs('Current_Project_State')?['body/vsb_order'],1)}"/>
		</filter>
	</entity>
</fetch>

<fetch version="1.0" mapping="logical" distinct="true">
	<entity name="vsb_projectstate">
		<attribute name="statecode"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_projectstateid"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_name"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_isvisibleonchecklist"/>
		<attribute name="vsb_order"/>
		<order attribute="vsb_order" descending="false"/>
		<filter type="and">
			<condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0"/>
   <condition attribute="vsb_isvisibleonchecklist" operator="eq" value="1"/>
   <condition attribute="vsb_order" operator="eq" value="@{add(outputs('Get_New_Project_State_Order_from_Default_Approvals')?['body/vsb_order'],1)}"/>
		</filter>
	</entity>
</fetch>
